tei:div.tei:p: (1na)rje dwags po lha rjes mdzad pa'i phyag rgya chen po rdo rje ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ phag mo'i gzhung mdo dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag rgya chen po rdo rje ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du sin+dhu ra'i dbang bskur ba ni/ dang po byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms la/ rang gi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros pas dkyil 'khor stong par bsgom/ de'i ngang las rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ gcer bu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas na gri gug /g.yon thod pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung du bcug pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba/ 'khor mkha' 'gro ma bzhis bskor ba/ de yang mdun du oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ g.yon du oṃ lā me huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lā mā ljang gu /rgyab tu dum skyes oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro hi nī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ma dmar mo// g.yas su oṃ rū pi nī huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ gzugs can ma ser mo// de rnams g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ spyan gsum pa (2na)gcer bu g.yon brkyang ba'o// de nas bsnyen pa grub tshad cig bskyal la/ de nas me long la dri'am chang gis rlan btab la/ sin+dhū ra btsags la gser gyi snyu gus chos 'byung*/ gru gsum nyis brtsegs bris pa'i nang du/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dgod/ logs rnams su g.yung drung ris re re dgod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal byas te/ btsag dmar pos gru gsum gnyis brtsegs bri/ logs rnams su g.yung drung ris re re dgod/ de'i dbus su mañdzi la dar dmar po'i steng du me long gzhag /mchod rdzas yang mar me bdun/ lha bshos bdun/ zan tog bdun/ sha lhu bdun/ me tog phung po bdun/ de'i mtha' ma mchod pa rnam pa lngas bskor/ khyad par me tog dmar po la sogs pa'i rigs mang po dang*/ a ka ru dang du ru ka la sogs pa'i dri mang po dang*/

tshogs kyi mchod pa ni sha'i rigs mang po dang*/ shin tu zhim pa'i chang mang po dang*/ 'bras (2ba)chan dang khur ba la sogs pa'i zas sna mang po bsags la/ de nas thod pa mtshan nyid dang ldan par chang blugs/ de'i nang du bdud rtsi blugs la bzhag /de nas yang skad cig mas lhar bskyed la/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa grub tshad bskyal/ de nas me long gi yig 'bru la skad cig mas rnal 'byor ma bskyed/ g.yung drung ris bzhi la mkha' 'gro rang bsgoms pa dang 'dra/ ma bzhi bskyed/ mdun nas g.yon skor du/ rang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer spros te/ u rgyan nas rnal 'byor ma 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ me long gi lha la bstims la gnyis su med par bsam ste/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir me long la dmigs la oṃ baṃ las phag mo dmar mo// haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma sngon mo// hriṃ maṃ las rmongs byed ma dkar mo// hriṃ hriṃ las skyong byed ma ser mo// hūm̐ hūm̐ las sreg byed ma ljang khu/ phaṭa phaṭa las tsaṇ+ḍi ka sngo skya bskyed la mchod/ sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i theb srin gyis thod pa'i chang la gru gsum zlum skor bde ba'i brda'/ gru gsum stong pa nyid kyi brda'/ nyis brtsegs bri ba'i tshul du bya/ dbus su hrīḥlas phag mo ser mo bskyed/ de nas thod pa'i chang gis lag pa'i lha mchod de zhu bas chang dang gnyis su med par bsam ste/ lag pa thod chang khar kha sbub ste/ des phag mo ser mo'i spyi bor phug la phag mo zhu ste chang dang ro gcig tu song bdud rtsir/ bar bsam ste/ chang des rdzas dang tshogs la gtor bas tshogs 'dod yon lnga zag med kyi bdud rtsir song bar bsam ste/ thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i rang bzhin du song bar bsam/ byin gyis brlabs pa la sogs pa gzhan bya mi dgos/ de nas nye ba'i snying po// oṃ hrī hūm̐ oṃ hrī traṃ badz+ra/

badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ la sogs pas mchod pa rnams dbul lo// de (3na)nas bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ dag pa chen po'i gzhal yas nas// rdo rje mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// mi 'gyur gnas pa'i gzhal yas nas// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// gter 'byung yid bzhin gzhal yas nas// rin chen mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// shes rab btsun mo'i bha ga nas// pad+ma mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas// las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// 'jig rten sna tshogs gzhal yas nas// sna tshogs mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol// nub phyogs u rgyan gzhal yas nas// rdo rje phag mo gshegs su gsol// rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum nas // don de de ring grub par mdzod// kyi bar gyis bstod do// de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni sin+dhu ra la me tog 'thor phyag 'tshal du bcug /bla ma rdo rje'i 'dzin pa la sogs pa bla ma rnams dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dpa' mo dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ de bzhin nyid kyi ye shes nam mkha' lta bus gang bar mdzad du gsol// smin par mdzad du gsol// yongs su smin par mdzad du gsol// shin tu smin par mdzad du gsol// bdud rtsi nor bu zhes lan gsum brjod do// de nas bla ma la phyag byas la mdun du bzhag la bsgom du gzhug pa'am/ yang na byin rlabs bya ste bdud rtsi lngas byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal steng du bzhag la rkang pa bla ma la maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa dbul du gzhug /bla ma dang bud+dha tha dad med par bltar gzhug /bla na med pa'i theg pa la dad pa bskyed/ bar du me tog thogs/ (3ba)gnyis gshibs/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang*/

ltag pa dgyed byas la/ 'og rlung drangs steng rlung mnan la/ rnal 'byor ma dang bla ma tha mi dad par spyi bor bsgom du bcug la/ dpral ba'am lte ba gang rung du me long chos 'byung bsams la/ shes pa gtad du bcug /sngags dang sgra dang ting nge 'dzin gyis 'bebs par bya'o// dmigs pa gtod du bcug pa rang gi lte ba'i sngags slob ma'i lte bar bcug ste/ lte ba dang dpral ba gnyis ka nas 'od zer byung bar bsam/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i snying ga nas 'od zer spros pas slob ma'i snying gar 'bugs par bsam/ des ma phebs na 'gyed du bcug la de ltar bya'o// thugs babs na spros bral/ gsung babs na saṃ skṛ ta'i skad la sogs pa chos smra/ sku babs na lus 'dar ba dang*/ 'phar ba gar byed pa 'byung ngo*// de rnams ni thun mong du 'gro /de nas me long gi lha la me tog 'thor phyag byas la/ yang rang la phyag 'tshal du bcug pa ste/ mdun du bzhag la mda' gzhu bstan/ dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs pas bum pa'i dbang gi dod yin/ de nas phag mgo bstan/ de nas thod pa bstan/ de nas rdo rje rgya gram bstan/ 'o khyod la dang po mda' gzhu bstan pa thabs shes rab ya ma bral ba'i brda' yin/ lha yab yum zhal sbyor du bsgom par dbang ba'i brda' yin/ de nas phag mgo bstan pa de/ rtog med kyi ye shes sgoms shig pa'i brda' yin/ de nas rdo rje rgya gram bstan pa de phrin las rnam pa bzhi la dbang ba'i brda' yin pas/ des bum pa'i dbang ngo sprad pa'o/// /de nas lce thog tu 'o ma la sogs pa bdud rtsi ril bu chang dang sbyar ba sran ma tsam/ mngar ba bzhag la/ de ming la spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil dang po mgrin pa dang*/ de nas lte ba dang*/ spyi bo/ yan chad du des nas lus (4na)thams cad bde bas gang bar bsgom/ bde ba phril phril ba bsgoms shig byas la en cig bsdad/ de nas bde ba la brten pa'i mi rtog pa sgom du bcug la/

de gsang dbang gi dod yin pas des rtsa rlung sgom pa la dbang*/ de nas bde ba la brten nas mi rtog sgom du bcug pa de shes rab ye shes kyi dod yin/ ye shes brdas mtshon pa/ des rtog med kyi ye shes sgom pa la dbang*/ de nas lag mthil bstan la ci 'dug bya// de nas rdo rje cig bzhag la ci 'dug bya// 'o khyod la lag ci yang ma mthong ba de chos thams cad ma skyes pa'i brda'/ pa stong pa bstan pa de/ chos thams cad skye ba ngo bo nyid kyi brda'/ med pa'i brda' yin/ de nas rdo rje bzhag pa de snang grags thams cad kyang glo bur ba'i brda' yin/ de nas se gol gsum gtogs pa de/ chos thams cad du ma ro gcig pa'i brda yin/ de rnams dbang bzhi pa'i dod yin/ phyag rgya chen po brda'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa bya ba yin/ de nas sems ngo sprod pa yin te/ phyag rgya chen po'i gnas mchog na// byang chub sems dpa' spyod pa'i blo gros bzhugs// zhes bya ba thengs gsum bskyar la phyag rgya chen po bsam du med pa'i brda'o// de nas sin+dhu ra'i ye shes sems dpa' gshegs/ dam tshig sems dpa' rang dang slob ma'i snying gar bsdu'o// tshogs bza' de nas rang gzhan thams cad phag mor gnas pas tshogs la rol/ de nas da la'i lha la zas phud gtor te thim par bsam/ chos skyong la gtor ma dbul/ sha cig dang*/ zan cig nangs par bu mo 'dod pa'i mdas ma phog pa cig la byin/ thod pa'i chang la dang po zlum bskor cig byas pa ni bde ba'i brda'/ gru gsum de stong pa'i brda'/ dbus kyi thig le rang rig pa'i brda'/ de'i steng du ro rdo rje ma bskyed/ bla ma sangs rgyas tha dad med par sgom du gzhug /bla na med pa'i theg pa la dad pa rab tu bskyed na/ 'grub pa ni byin gyis brlabs nas shes par bya ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs bla ma rin po che'i thugs nas phyung ba rdzogs so// ༈ //bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po byang chub kyi sems sngon du song ba dang*/

skad cig gis (4ba)rang nyid lha mor bsgoms pa'i snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma'i steng du hrī bsam/ de nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ jo mo 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ jo mo dang bla ma tha mi dad du bsam la yan lag bdun pa bya'o// de nas lha gshegs su gsol/ badz+ra muḥzhes yid kyis bya'o// swa bhā was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis rnal 'byor mar bskyed la/ lte bar gru gsum me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi dbus hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ thams cad phag mor gyur nas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim yongs su gyur pa las phag mo'o// rdo rje phag mo la gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas/ thod pa dum bu gcig pa la sogs par/ sha chang bdud rtsi la sogs pa'i gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa bshams/ de nas rang lhar bsams nas/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par byas pa'i gtor ma'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa me 'od dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyed bu gsum/ de'i steng du āḥlas thod pa rgya che ba'i nang du rdzas rnams bsgom/ de'i dbus su mu las dri chu bai ḍūr+ya lta bu dang*/ shar du bi las dri chen shel lta bu/ lhor raḥlas rak+ta ser btso ma lta bu/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar dmar byi ru lta bu/ byang du ma las klad pa in+d+ra nī la lta bu ste bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ de rnams kyi steng gi dbus su na las mi yi sha /shar lhor go las rta'i sha /lho nub tu ku las khyi'i sha /nub byang du da las ba lang gi sha /byang shar du ha las glang po che'i sha rnams bsam/ de nas rang gi (5na)sna bug nas rlung byung bas ba dan skyod/ rlung gis me sbar/

thod pa dros/ rdzas rnams khol/ sngags rnams zhu/ mi gtsang ba rnams phyir lud de/ dmar ser sbrang rtsi lta bu'i bdud rtsi gyur par bsam/ de'i steng du oṃ/ de'i steng du āḥde'i steng du hūṃ bsam zhing brjod pas/ oṃ gyis mang po dang*/ āḥzhes pas zag med kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ hūṃ gis rdo rje'i lte ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug /rdo rje'i bu ga na mar babs par bsam/ de nas rdo rjes dkrug pas 'dres par bsam/ oṃ e ā ra li hoḥdzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥbadz+ra ḍā ki nī ye sa mā ya twaṃ dṛsh+ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla na gnas pa'i mgron rnams mdun du byon par bsam/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i pad steng gi hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ de dag la phog pas/ rdo rje phag mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa dus gcig la bsam mo// de nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ste/ oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu nas yar gsol bar bsam/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab bo/// /rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rten gyi gang zag dad pa dang ldan pas/ dur khrod la sogs pa dben pa'i gnas su ras ris dang*/ lugs ma la sogs pa bkram nas/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste byang chub kyi sems sngon du song nas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mar wal gyis bsgom/ de'ang rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa ste/ pad+ma nyi ma ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ g.yon brkyang*/ g.yas (5ba)bskum pa/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dmar ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon na bsnams pa/

phyag rgya lngas rab tu brgyan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa'i do shal byas pa/ snyan gong g.yas na phag zhal dang rab tu ldan pa/ de lta bu'i rgyan cha lugs dang ldan pa skad cig bskyed la/ snying khar pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phag mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa sdig pa bshags pa yan chad byas la/ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas/ 'og min gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa ni/ byams pa/ dga' ba/ snying rje/ btang snyoms so// de nas swa bhā was sgyu ma lta bur bsam/ shūn+ya tās stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma ro'i gdan steng du hrīḥdamar po zhig bsam/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ rgyan cha lugs dang ldan par wal gyis bsam/ de yang shin tu che ba lte ba man chad 'dod khams su 'dug pa/ snying ga man chad gzugs khams su 'dug pa/ spyi bo man chad gzugs med khams su 'dug pa/ khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ma shin tu che ba zhig bsam/ de'i lte bar gru gsum me'i dkyil 'khor cig bsam/ de'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma/ ro'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po cig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog sdig sgrib sbyangs nas/ jo mo rnal 'byor mar byas/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim par bsam/ hrīḥde skad cig gis yongs su (6na)gyur pa las/ bdag nyid jo mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ g.yas gri khug /g.yon thod pa/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mchan khung g.yon du bsnams pa/ phag zhal g.yas su blta ba/ gcer bu spyan gsum pa/ skal pa 'jig dus kyi me lta bu/ rgyan cha lugs dang ldan par skad gis bsam pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūṃ/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab par bya'o// de nas dpa' bo'i go cha dgod pa ni/ lte ba/

snying ga mgrin pa/ dpral ba/ spyi bor dang*/ yan lag thams cad rim pa bzhin du shes par bya'o// de nas rang gi snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po gcig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros te 'og min nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te/ rang dang gnyis su med par yi ge

dzaḥhūṃ bam̐ hoḥ bzhis bstim mo// yang snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min gyi gnas nas jo mo lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma lā mā/ dum skyes ma/ gzugs can ma bzhis thod pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga thogs te mchod par bsam/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi gtso mo la thim pas/ gtso mo bde ba'i rang bzhin/ 'khor rnams kyang bde ba'i rang bzhin no// de nas yang me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ mar me ma/ dri chab ma/ zhal zas ma/ rnams kyis kyang mchod par bsam mo// de nas gsol ba lan mang du gdab bo// de nas rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi lha mo phyung ste/ phyag gnyis kyis khrus kyi bum pa dang*/ me tog sil ma thogs nas/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu me tog oṃ byang chub rdo rjes (6ba)sangs rgyas la// ji ltar mchod cing gsol ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ gtor zhing*// khrus kyi bum pas chu blugs te dbang bskur bar bsam mo// chu zhabs gyen la 'khyil bas/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam mo// de nas phyag dang mchod pa byas nas/ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas 'og min gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ lte ba'i dkyil du gru gsum nyis brtsegs g.yung drung ris dang bcas pa/ dbus su sngags tshan gsum pos 'khor ba bris la/ de 'khor ba la du ba la sogs pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar du bsgom par bya'o// oṃ oṃ oṃ/ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye/ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes rtag tu bzlas par bya'o// dpal rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas gsungs pa/ bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'di/ blo dman rnams kyi brjed byang tsam zhig yi ger bkod/

rje btsun mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas bzod par gsol/ snang sems zhen med kyi lha sku la// sgyu ma'i yid dang mi 'bral 'tshal// sku gsum ngo sprod kyi rje btsun la// dad gus kyi yid dang mi 'bral 'tshal// rang bzhin skye med 'od gsal la// gcer mthong gi yid dang mi 'bral 'tshal// spyod pa rang byung 'gag med la// chos nyid kyi nyams dang mi 'bral 'tshal// 'di'i yig sna/ rje dwags po sgom tshul gyis mdzad pa lags/// / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thun mtshams su rdo rje phag mo la gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas 'di ltar bya'o// bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ gtor ma bshams la/ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba (7na)dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes bya bas gtor ma de stong par bya'o// stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ skya bo gsum bsam/ de zhu ba las mi mgo'i sgyed po gsum gyi tshul du bsam par bya'o// de gsum gyi steng du āḥdakar po gcig bsam/ de zhu ba las thod pa nang dmar ba phyi skya ba gcig bsam/ de'i nang du rang rang gi sa bon las/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga bskyed par bya ste/ de yang shar du baṃ las dri chen/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems dkar po/ byang du ma las sna tshogs sha /dbus su mu las dri chu bskyed/ de'i rjes la/ shar du dri chen gyi steng du/ ku las khyi'i sha /lhor rak+ta'i steng du/ da las glang po che'i sha /nub tu byang sems dkar po'i steng du/ ha las ba lang gi sha /byang du sna tshogs pa'i steng du/ go las rta'i sha /dbus su dri chu'i steng du/ na las mi'i sha bsam/ rdzas de rnams kyi steng du bdud rtsi'i ngo bo oṃ dkar po gcig bsam/ yang de'i steng du āḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ hūṃ mtshan rdo rje dkar po cig bsam/ 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dbyibs gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa'o// rlung gis thod pa'i me sbar te/

thod pa dros pa dang*/ rdzas rnams zhu ba'i rlangs pa oṃ la phog pas/ 'od zer kha dog lnga'i rang bzhin 'phros te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas/ dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la bstim ste/ zla ba dang oṃ zhu nas/ rdo rjes dam tshig gi bdud rtsi dang*/ ye shes bdud rtsi gnyis su med par dkrugs te/ rdo rje yang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu bar byas nas/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ (7ba)zhes lan gsum brjod de/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtor ma sbyang ba'o// de'i rjes la phaiṃ gi sgra brjod cing drwa ba'i phyag rgya byas la bskor ba dang*/ bskor min gyi tshul du lan drug bskor la/ lag pa gnyis gshibs te kha phye la/ thod pa'i phyag rgya bcas pa de bdud rtsi rnams kyis gang bar bsams la/ oṃ e ā ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ da ni ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams dang*/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rnams la snyan gsan dbab cing gtor ma 'bul lo// bsngo ba'i sngags ni/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sar+b+ba yak+sha rak+ṣā sa/ sarba bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ u ṣ+man+da/ a pa smā ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yī dha ya/ i daṃ ba ling*/ gṛ h+ṇan+tu/ sa ma yā rak+ṣan+tu/ ma ma sarbā sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan du/ ya thai baṃ/ ya theṣ+ṭaṃ/ bhu dza thā/ dzi gh+ra thā/ pi ba thā/ mā ti kra ma thā/ ma ma sarbā ka ra ta ya/ sad su khaṃ bi shud+dhe sa ha yak+ki bha wan+tu hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pas bsngos la/ de'i rjes la 'byung po dang*/ chos skyong la'ang bsngo bar bya'o// bla ma rin po che'i zhal gyi gdams ngag yi ger bkod pa'o// de'i rjes la bden stobs brjod do// bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dag dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*// chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis// don rnams gang dag bsam pa dang*// de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur cig

/ces pa dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa dang*// zhi dang (8na)rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyi bdag la srungs// dngos grub kun gyi stongs grogs mdzod// dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs sogs zhi ba dang*// bkra shis phun sum tshogs par mdzod// tshe ring tshogs bskyed bsam pa yi// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu mdzod// ces pa yang brjod do// de'i rjes la lha bcu gsum nas gsungs pa'i/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang*// de rnams sras dang bcas pa yi// 'jig rten skyong rnams cho ga 'dis// ma tshang ba dag bzod par gsol// zhi dang bkra shis bde legs dang*// zhes pa la sogs pas bzod par gsol la/ badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ bla ma'i zhal gyi de nyid ni// gtor ma'i de nyid bsdus pa yin// rdo rje phag mo'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so// ༈ //stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid// bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dud// dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bde ba rang bzhin ma skyes pa// ji bzhin du ni rtogs gyur pa// gzhan don mthar phyin mdzad pa yi// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal 'dud// g.yon pa chags sogs khro mo'i zhal// g.yas pa rtog med phag gdong zhal// bdag med skye med chos kyi dbyings// rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal 'dud// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtogs pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal 'dud// bde gshegs sku la gnyis med 'khril// zag med bde ba sku nyams bstar// lte ba'i dbus nas 'byung bzhi 'phro// chos dang longs spyod rdzogs par ldan// mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dud mdzad ma// phag mo de la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod pa yang bya'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// /
